_comment: Epoxy — Hermes Agent Free-Tier Proxy. Pools multiple Groq + Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling.
name: Epoxy
author: epoxy@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Epoxy pools multiple free-tier Groq and Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Point Hermes Agent at it via custom_providers.

Hermes config.yaml:
  custom_providers:
    free-pool:
      base_url: http://<server-ip>:{{SERVER_PORT}}

Then use /model <model-name> in Hermes.

Models:
  - groq-llama-3.1-8b-instant  (or any Groq model)
  - ollama-deepseek-v3.1       (or any Ollama model)

installation.script:
# Epoxy — no build step required; the Docker image is pre-built.
# API keys are configured via the egg variables below.
echo "Epoxy container started. Configure your API keys in the Startup tab."

variables.name: Groq API Keys
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Groq API keys for round-robin rotation.

variables.name: Ollama Cloud API Keys
variables.description: Comma-separated list of Ollama Cloud API keys for round-robin rotation.

variables.name: Groq Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Ollama Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: Port the proxy listens on internally.
